senses.gloss:
ऊर्ज् €10 P., Ā. To be strong; powerful, be happy; अदत् पिबदूर्जयमानमाशितम्
 Rv. 10. 37. 11.

ऊर्ज् f. [P. III. 2. 177]
—1 Strength, vigour.
—2 Sap, juice.
—3 Water.
—4 Food; स देवानपि गच्छति स ऊर्जमुपजीवति Bṛ. Up. 1. 5. 1.
 oft. with इष्; इषे त्वा ऊर्जे त्वा Ts. 1. 1. 1. 1^1; इषमूर्जं सुक्षितिम्
 &c. नम ऊर्ज इषे Bhāg. 4. 24. 38.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/44aba84e.

उर्जित p. p.
—1 Aged, strong, powerful.
—2 Abandoned, left.

ऊर्जित a.
—1
——(a) Powerful, strong, mighty; श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा Bg. 10. 41;
 मातृकं च धनुरूर्जितं दधत् R. 11. 64; cf. also बाणाक्षरैरेव
 परस्परस्य नामोर्जितं चापभृतः शशंसुः vigorous, strong (speech);
 Śi. 16. 38; ऊर्जितं क्षात्रं तेजः Ve. 1. 13.
——(b) Great, large, exceeding, much; धनुर्विस्फारयामास तडिदूर्जितनिःस्वनम्
 Rām. 5. 48. 25; Mv. 2. 13.
—2 Distinguished, glorious, superior; excellent, beautiful; ˚श्रीः
 Śi. 16. 85; मकरोर्जितकेतनम् R. 9. 39, 1. 93; Māl. 7. 4.
[]
—3 High, noble, spirited; ऊर्जितः खलु ते कामः Rām. 2. 85. 2. ˚आश्रयं
 वचः Ki. 2. 1 spirited or noble.
—4 Increased; deep, grave; अलङ्घ्यत्वाज्जनैरन्यैः क्षुभितोदन्वदूर्जितम् Ki. 11. 40.

—1 N. of the month Kārtika (as giving vigour and energy); ‘बाहुलोर्जौ कार्तिकिकः’ इत्यमरः;
 ऊर्जमतङ्गजम् Śi. 6. 50.
—2 Energy.
—3 Power, strength.
—4 Procreative power.
—5 Life, breath.
—6 N. of the sons of हिरण्यगर्भ (reckoned among the seven Ṛṣis
 of the third Manvantara).

ऊर्जः + .{@-र्जा@}
—1 Food ऊर्जावती (गङ्गा) Mb. 13. 26. 84.
—2 Energy.
—3 Strength, sap. नाप्यूर्जां बिभरामास वैदेह्यां प्रसितो भृशम् Bk. 6. 3.
—4 Growth.
—5 N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Vasiṣṭha.
ऊर्जः + -मेध a. Of eminent intelligence, very wise; Hc.

ऊर्जयति Den. P.
—1 To feed, strengthen, nourish.
—2 (Ā.) To become strong or powerful.

ऊर्जव्य a. Ved. Abounding in food or strength. सिषक्तु न ऊर्जव्यस्य
 पुष्टेः Rv. 5. 41. 20.

ऊर्जस्वत् a.
—1 Rich in food; juicy, succulent; ऊर्जस्वतीः पयस्वतीः प्रजावतीः Ts. 1. 1. 1. 1^1.
—2 Powerful, strong, vigorous.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/44aba84e.

ऊर्जस्वल a. [ऊर्जस्-वलच्]
—1 Great, powerful, strong mighty; तद्रक्ष … ऊर्जस्वलमात्मदेहम्
 R. 2. 50; Bk. 3. 55; Mv. 4. 35; Māl. 2. 9.
—2 Excellent, pre-eminent; U. 4.
ऊर्जस्विन् a. Mighty, strong, great; U. 5. 27, v. l.

ऊर्जस्विन् + .{@-नी@} A figure of Rhetoric, speaking of anything with contempt,
 description of violence.
